{{recipe}}

'''Green sauce''' is a dish that originates from the Frankfurt/Main region of Germany.

== Ingredients ==
* 3–4 [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]] (200 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]] / 7 [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]] per cup) [[Cookbook:Sour Cream|sour cream]]
* [[Cookbook:Milk|Milk]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] [[Cookbook:Sunflower Oil|sunflower oil]] (or other oil of neutral taste)
* 2 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[Cookbook:Lemon Juice|lemon juice]]
* 4 [[Cookbook:Hard Boiled Eggs|hard-boiled eggs]]
* 10–15 large [[Cookbook:Potato|potatoes]]
* 1–1½ empty sour cream cups filled with [[Cookbook:Dill|dill]]
* 1–1½ empty sour cream cups filled with other mixed herbs (e.g. [[Cookbook:Chive|chives]], [[Cookbook:Parsley|parsley]], onion leaves, lemon balm, burnet, a small amount of [[Cookbook:Sorrel|sorrel]] if available)

== Procedure ==

# Combine sour cream, oil, and lemon juice. Add milk until the mixture takes the consistency of a thick sauce.
# Mix herbs well, and mix them into the sauce.
# Cut hard-boiled eggs to small pieces and add them to the sauce along with some salt and pepper.
# Leave the sauce in the fridge for about 1–1½.
# [[Cookbook:Boiling|Boil]] potatoes and serve hot with the cold sauce. More hard-boiled eggs can also be served along with this.
